note: HSS points are one-second steady windows; short exploratory measurements, not long-run acceptance. RTT rows validate the complete producer sequence and RAM/register restoration.

run_notes.rtt_speed_first: Only completed 50MHz rows are used in the review. A later 60MHz point hit a 4-byte producer-counter snapshot race; the script now reconciles its counter against WrOff. The corrected 60MHz run is rtt_60_baseline_fixed.
